app_summary: An online shop selling astronomy products, based on the OpenTelemetry Demo. It is built with polyglot microservices (Go, Java, .NET, Python, Node.js, Rust, ...) communicating via gRPC and HTTP behind an Envoy frontend-proxy, with Kafka for asynchronous order processing, Valkey as cart store and flagd for feature flags. Supported Operations: View product catalog, Receive product recommendations and ads, Add item to cart, Checkout with selected items, Currency conversion, Process payment, Generate shipping quotes, Send order confirmation emails
RCA_gt: The Kafka queue is overloaded: the feature flag 'kafkaQueueProblems' is enabled, flooding the orders topic with messages while introducing a delay on the consumer side (accounting/fraud-detection), causing a large consumer lag spike.
port_forward_command: kubectl port-forward -n astronomy-shop $(kubectl get pod -n astronomy-shop -l app.kubernetes.io/name=jaeger -o name | head -1) 16687:16686
